entity.name: Ashutosh Kumar Singh
entity.description: Software engineer, security researcher, and Bazel contributor building next-generation build tooling in Rust.

projects.name: Hyperblaze
projects.description: An async-native build graph engine written in Rust. Hyperblaze uses Rust async/await for incremental dependency suspension instead of restart protocols, and targets the developer experience pain points of Bazel and Buck2 for small-to-medium Rust monorepos.

channels.description: GitHub Sponsors profile for one-time and recurring support.

plans.name: Phase 1 - file watcher daemon and early cutoff
plans.description: Implement the file watcher daemon using the notify crate, persistent graph cache, and early cutoff algorithm. This makes no-op rebuilds near-instant and is the key demo milestone.

plans.name: 3 months full-time development
plans.description: Full-time work on Phases 1-2: daemon, early cutoff, 50-crate monorepo benchmark, hyperfine CI, technical blog post, and public launch.
